attchmntText: Dharani Sugars & Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026
voiceSummary: Dharani Sugars and Chemicals Limited published newspaper advertisements regarding its un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published on November 1 and 4, 2026, in Makkal Kural and Financial Express. Avalon Technologies Limited reported its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were audited by the audit committee on November 11, 2026, and approved by the board of directors on November 12, 2026. Avalon Technologies reported revenue from operations of 2,555.82 million rupees and net profit of 210.23 million rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. CR Metals Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The results were approved by the board of directors on November 13, 2026. Federal Bank Limited filed a case against S. Dinesh in the Additional Commercial Court, Chennai. The defendant is summoned to appear on November 25, 2026. Radisson Blu Resort Temple Bay Mamallapuram filed a case against WV Connect Private Limited. The defendant is summoned to appear on December 1, 2026.

attchmntText: Dharani Sugars & Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Dharani Sugars and Chemicals Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. The statutory auditor issued a qualified report citing material uncertainties regarding the company's ability to continue as a going concern. Manufacturing facilities have remained non-operational for a prolonged period. The company defaulted on its Master Restructuring Agreement with India Debt Resolution Company Limited, leading to the cancellation of the arrangement. Estimated overdue obligations stood at INR 59.2 Crores as at September 30, 2026. The auditor noted that borrowings of INR 9,690 lakhs should have been reclassified as current liabilities. Additionally, the company defaulted on a Sugar Development Fund loan of INR 6,111 Lakhs and other debts including INR 3,130.69 Lakhs to Heart Properties Private Limited. Outstanding dues to directors and related parties totaled INR 21,963.19 Lakhs. The equity shares have been suspended from trading since July 03, 2023.
